energyAllocation.description: Each turn, players allocate energy from their ship's power sources to various systems. Energy is the limiting resource — there is never enough to power everything at full capacity.

powerSources.name: Warp Engines
powerSources.description: Primary power source. Energy output depends on the number of undestroyed warp engine boxes on the SSD. Left and right engines may have different outputs.
powerSources.notes: Damaged warp engines reduce available energy, creating a cascading disadvantage.

powerSources.name: Impulse Engines
powerSources.description: Secondary power source providing additional energy. Also used for sublight movement.

powerSources.name: Auxiliary Reactors
powerSources.description: Additional power sources available on some ships. Provide fixed energy output.

powerSources.name: Batteries
powerSources.description: Store energy from previous turns for use in future turns. Limited capacity. Can be used for Reserve Power to activate systems mid-turn.
powerSources.notes: Reserve Power allows powering systems not allocated in the Energy Allocation phase, but is limited.

powerSources.name: Capacitors
powerSources.description: Store energy specifically for weapon overload. Allow weapons to fire at increased damage.

allocationCategories.description: Energy allocated to maintain warp engine function. Determines ship's speed.
allocationCategories.cost: Varies by speed. Higher speed = more energy.

allocationCategories.description: Energy allocated to impulse engines for additional movement capability.
Minimum energy to activate shields. Shields must be activated to function.
Additional energy to absorb damage. General reinforcement is divided by 2. Directed reinforcement goes to specific shields.
allocationCategories.cost: 1 energy = 1 directed reinforcement point; 2 energy = 1 general reinforcement point

allocationCategories.description: Energy to arm and fire weapons. Different weapons require different amounts.
allocationCategories.cost: Varies by weapon type and size

allocationCategories.description: Extra energy to increase weapon damage. Overloaded weapons score double damage (in most cases) but have reduced range (max 8 hexes).
ECM (Electronic Countermeasures) to reduce incoming damage and ECCM (Electronic Counter-Countermeasures) to maintain own weapons effectiveness.
allocationCategories.notes: At medium to long ranges, ECM can be more efficient than shield reinforcement.

allocationCategories.description: Energy for cloaking devices, tractor beams, transporters, labs, and other special equipment.
Energy for basic ship functions. Usually free or minimal cost.

energyAllocationForm.description: A form filled out at the start of each turn. Systems not allocated energy cannot be used during the turn (except via Reserve Power from batteries).
